claims.title: Closed-host capillary assembly: hydraulic screens, renewal and service limits

quoted_fields.interface: Proposed36mm OD/33mm ID316L host; four1mm fluid ports and two1.8mm service ports; .8mm OD/.5mm ID FEP stock, reusable rails/clips and1.7mm custom micro-Y. External routing and borescope tools withdraw before passive use.
quoted_fields.failure: Nominal commercial tubing/component ratings do not qualify installed bends, junctions, seals or proof strength. No full swept-path/contact-mechanics or recovery experiment was performed. Campaign yield and timing are introduced scenarios, not measured reliability/throughput. Linked model ZIP/report remain uncollected.
